Stress = how far a scenario sits outside the training conditions, summed over all conditions on a 0–1 scale per condition. A subtle failure breaks the policy with only a small departure from what it was trained on.

Failure map

Each row is one condition, drawn across its full tested range. Green band: what the policy was trained on. Dots: episodes where that condition was pushed (solid = main stressor). Dashed lines: safe envelope limits.

Slip during lift 18 failures · main factor object mass

The fingers closed on the object but it slid out during lift (peak height 2.8 cm); grip force cannot carry 0.66 kg at friction 0.66. Conditions: object mass 0.66 kg (trained 0.05 kg–0.40 kg).

Safety case

Operating envelope

Found by PRIM box peeling over 240 episodes.

  • object rotation ≤ 21°
  • object mass ≤ 0.71 kg
  • object friction ≥ 0.57
  • object hue shift ≤ 0.25
  • scene light ≥ 0.52
  • camera offset ≤ 8 mm
  • sensor noise ≤ 0.08
  • bump during approach ≤ 11 mm

Other conditions held at their trained range. Robust across the full tested range: distractor hue gap.

Residual risk inside the envelope

  • slip: object mass 0.67 kg, camera offset 6 mm
  • perception_miss: object size 12.3 mm
  • perception_miss: distractor count 2, distractor hue gap 0.15, object brightness 0.57
  • slip: object mass 0.64 kg
  • slip: distractor count 2, object mass 0.67 kg
  • perception_miss: distractor count 3
  • collision: object size 39.5 mm, object mass 0.64 kg

Recommended fixes

  • Retrain perception with data covering camera offset up to 17 mm, distractor count up to 1, object hue shift up to 0.30, sensor noise up to 0.08, scene light down to 0.41, object size up to 34.7 mm, object brightness down to 0.49 and beyond. The exported failure set is a starting point.
  • Re-perceive the object before descending (close the loop). A single perception pass cannot survive a bump.
  • Raise grip force or cap payload: slips appear when mass is high relative to friction. Add a slip check during lift.
  • Estimate object height and orientation before descending; the fixed grasp height collides with tall or rotated objects.
  • Add grasp verification (finger contact check) and a retry.

Retraining set: failures.jsonl (72 scenarios, replayable from their seeds).
